## Annotation

The page defines CSIL as a self-directed option: clients receive funds from their health authority and become employers, or a client support group / representative may act as employer. It lists eligibility (home-support assessment, high physical care needs, medical stability, available resources, client rate, ability to manage or have a substitute employer) and publishes hourly rates for 2022–2024. It points to the CSIL Online Workbook and to the Continuing Care Fees Regulation for the client-rate formula.

This is evidence of the **current** public program, not of founding dates.

## Open questions
